mission.title: Bootstrap
mission.description: Drive off a Zionite patrol, receive Helian's combat routines, and put them to the test.

phase.briefing: Your continued monitoring of that district is appreciated, operative. We have indications of an active Zionite presence nearby.

enter.say: Yep, looks like they're still chasing their golden dream girl. aka the interface program. Let's just see what we can do about that.

near.say: This is how you show your appreciation?!
This is how you show your appreciation?!

phase.briefing: {player}, we've received a request for your presence from Helian. His location is indicated for you.

enter.say: Hah, and before he was all "I don't think we'll need your help." I knew they'd run into trouble.

talk.say: Yes. I've noticed the other "Awakened" have been interfering. I thought you might be able to use some assistance. I'll provide you with several combat routines.
These programs are effective in combat, and can follow basic directional prompts. Use them correctly, and they'll take care of the problem for you.

objective.text: Lead the two Override Functions out of the area

phase.briefing:
Zionite pursuit of the interface program has evidently caused the Oligarchs more trouble than they had anticipated, operative.
Those two override programs appear to perform as Helian described. Attempt to lead them to the area of hostile resistance that you see indicated.

enter.say: Got reds in the vicinity. Let's see what those Functions can do...

near.say:
Hm, I could swear that--
Oho, there they are! Hostiles heading your way!

A Machi--
Er...
Hey, look, guys! Must be one of those Zionites that've been bugging the Machines! We'd better do them a favor and take 'em out, right?
Mervs! What's their angle on this?

mission.finish:
Operative, sources indicate that an exiled program working for the Merovingian has obtained sensitive information on Oligarch activities here.
Merovingian interference could cause undesirable complications in the current situation; please see to the elimination of this annoyance.
The Exile's name is Azuna; last known location: northwest Downtown.
